We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first three templates, but need to continue with 149040 and 1914391. Also need to construct full route JSON with molecules and reactions.

We need to ensure each template is applicable; we may need to adjust intermediate molecules.

First template 29646 applied to target gave three possible precursors (list of three). The result was a tuple of three strings? Actually result shows three possible outcomes: each is a tuple with one SMILES? It shows (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))

So three possible precursors. Choose one that can go through next templates.

We tried first precursor with 1914389 and got two products: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' (maybe two fragments). That seems like a disconnection giving two fragments: a protected cyclic molecule and a side chain.

We need to apply template 1914390 next to something. We attempted on the first fragment but got no result. Maybe need to apply 1914390 to the second fragment? Let's try apply 1914390 to 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'.
